text: The site is largely conformant with WCAG 2.2 at level AA. Two areas are not: the older PDF service reports before 2021 are unstructured scans, and the plant logbook's chart view has no table alternative yet. Both are scheduled for the first half of 2027.
note: Reports go to a named person in the service department, not to a form. You will get an answer within five working days, and we will tell you whether and when the barrier will be removed.
